usage: agent-run start [-h] --runtime RUNTIME --model MODEL --profile PROFILE
                       --task TASK [--workdir WORKDIR] [--write] [--fast]
                       [--effort EFFORT] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                       [--read-root READ_ROOT] [--output-schema OUTPUT_SCHEMA]
                       [--request-id REQUEST_ID] [--account ACCOUNT] [--wait]
                       [--session-transport SESSION_TRANSPORT]
                       [--session-id SESSION_ID]
                       [--session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --runtime RUNTIME
  --model MODEL
  --profile PROFILE
  --task TASK
  --workdir WORKDIR
  --write
  --fast
  --effort EFFORT
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --read-root READ_ROOT
  --output-schema OUTPUT_SCHEMA
  --request-id REQUEST_ID
  --account ACCOUNT
  --wait
  --session-transport SESSION_TRANSPORT
  --session-id SESSION_ID
  --session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID
